jobs.description:
We’re Looking for Technicians!
We’re recruiting for a company in Ruiselede that specializes in sustainable and energy-efficient installations.

Do you value sustainability? Do you want to make a meaningful impact on your community?

Then be sure to read on!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll be responsible for installing charging stations, heat pumps, and solar panels
• You’ll perform installation work
• You’ll work on-site, departing from Ruiselede at 7:00 a.m. 

Who are you?

• You have experience in the construction industry
• You’re not afraid of heights
• You can handle a bit of wind (you’ll be working outdoors)
• You’re flexible, eager to learn, and honest
• You’re open to starting work under an IBO contract
• You have a Class B driver’s license and your own car
• You speak English or Dutch

Are you a handy jack-of-all-rounder with a passion for maintenance? Then I’m looking for you!

For a company in Aalter that specializes in structural steel, I’m looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll perform preventive and corrective maintenance on pneumatic, mechanical, and hydraulic systems.
• You’ll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.
• You’ll work in a technical team where everyone is committed to optimization.
• You’ll strictly adhere to safety regulations.
• You’ll conduct quality checks.

Who are you?

• You have a technical mindset! This is reflected in your experience or technical training.
• You preferably have knowledge of pneumatic, hydraulic, and/or mechanical systems.
• You have experience with preventive maintenance.
• You are passionate about troubleshooting and resolving issues.
• You speak English or Dutch.
• Polish or Romanian is a plus!

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 
Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.
Responsibilities

• Help define, implement and maintain highly available, performant & scalable database systems to effectively meet IT Business requirements

• Be involved in deployment and patching automation

• Maintain (backups, transaction log management, index optimisation etc) and upgrade the database systems etc

• Review database schema changes to ensure compliance with standards and ensure optimal choice of indexing, column definitions etc.

• Help with problem solving in case of performance problems or functional issues in applications

• Build a strong relationship both within the infrastructure team and with the development teams

• Promote best practices

• Maintain the deployment pipeline

Additional details

Seniority: Medior/Senior

Start Date: October/November

Duration: Long-term

Extension: Yes

Contract: Freelance

Location: Brussels

Onsite Policy: 50%

Hours Per Week: 40

Languages: Fluent English and French/Dutch

Interview Process: 1 stage

• Expert knowledge of SQL Server administration, performance tuning, high availability and disaster recovery

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle and enterprise database operations

• Hands-on experience with AWS database services (Aurora, RDS for SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL, DynamoDB)

• Experience with Azure database services (Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, CosmosDB)

• Strong troubleshooting skills across database, operating system and infrastructure layers

• Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation

• Good knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Red Hat Linux

 

Strongly preferred:

• Experience with TerraForm, Ansible or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools

• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Redgate , Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or equivalent

• Experience modernising legacy database platforms

• Experience with GIT, Jira and CI/CD-driven deployment processes

• Experience with cloud security, encryption, backup and disaster recovery solutions

• Experience with performance monitoring and capacity management in cloud environments

• Knowledge of Power BI, SSAS or reporting platforms

 

Nice to have:

• VMware vSphere and ESXi administration knowledge

• CommVault or enterprise backup solutions

• Basic networking and load-balancing (F5) concepts

• Azure Entra ID and Azure platform services

• Basic knowledge of Go or Python programming language

Soft skills

• Good communication skills enabling you to explain complex technical issues is an easy-to-understand way

• Like to keep up to date with the latest technology trends

• Fluent English and good knowledge of either French or Dutch

• Advanced investigation & problem solving skills with strong analytical skills

• Availability & flexibility

• Interested in cloud technologies and what the future may bring

• Have a clean certificate of good behaviour

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.
• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.
• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.
• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.
• Fluent in English

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Analyst / Developer Mainframe (Cobol / PL1)
jobs.description:
Ready to take ownership of complex systems and contribute to meaningful digital transformation?

We're looking for an experienced Mainframe Analyst Developer who enjoys designing reliable, scalable solutions and ensuring the continuity of critical applications that serve thousands of users every day.

This is an opportunity to join a human-centered organization where your expertise is valued, your ideas make a difference, and your work-life balance truly matters.
🎯 Your role

As a key member of our development team, you will:

• Lead the technical analysis, design, development, and maintenance of core business applications

• Work on multiple layers - from business logic to system integration and user interfaces

• Translate functional needs into robust, long-term technical solutions

• Ensure the stability, performance, and quality of existing systems while contributing to modernization initiatives

• Collaborate closely with internal teams and act as a technical reference for less experienced developers

• Document and communicate your work clearly to both technical and business stakeholders

💡 What defines you

• You're results-oriented and motivated by technical excellence.

• You value quality, precision, and structured work.

• You're autonomous but thrive in a collaborative environment.

• You take initiative and enjoy improving processes and solutions.

• You communicate clearly and enjoy being a trusted technical advisor.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in software development, ideally with Mainframe systems

• Proficient in procedural programming languages such as C, Cobol, or PL/1

• Solid understanding of relational databases (SQL, DB2, etc.)

• Languages:

• 

• Strong written and spoken command of French and/or Dutch

• Good working knowledge of technical English

 

Additional assets:

• Experience with z/OS, PL/1, CICS, JCL, SOA/ESB, TWS, Web Services, or Java.

• Knowledge of accounting principles or financial applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a focus on system reliability and performance.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:

• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines
• Processing and assembling wooden components
• Performing quality checks on finished products
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)
• Is not afraid of physical work
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:

• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:

• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.
